mergedSourceAcceptance.reviewScope: Reviewed every job outcome and downloaded the exact merged source plus model and market reports. All ten original runtime reports were independently reviewed before merge; a second download of every duplicate report is not claimed.

publication.scope: Every checked-in public game file and its applied library note matched the exact release snapshot; unrelated sibling files may advance.
publication.independentSourceHashComparison: All 209 public hashes independently matched the reviewed merged source. The applied library note was also checked against Git blob f6b8ec69ffb77982aed931fd7520a0e90e1c5d0c.

deployment.explanation: Concurrent sibling publications superseded earlier queued Pages snapshots. The successful later snapshot contains the unchanged Working Quay release. No cancelled deployment is counted as successful, no older repository snapshot was force-published, and every game-file hash remained required.

comparisonScope: Individual synthetic-input traversals beginning at a naturally recurring loading phase. These are simulation timings, not average-player times, hardware frame rates, or proof of enjoyment. No actor, inventory or objective assignment manufactured the live comparison.
resolvedFailure: The reached fixed signal previously inherited a free-bell visibility check and rejected hand Interact when the cart moved behind a warehouse corner. The corrected code preserves reach and visibility to the fixed post while relaying the request. The free bell stays local and sight-dependent. The unchanged assertion now passes in source, merged-master and public tracked-controller/hand tests.

preserved.reward: Original 600-credit exactly-once chapter ledger; no new reward or writes to original-neighborhood saves.
preserved.controls: Familiar direct Xbox actions and real neutral rearm; tracked-controller and joint-pinch Interact at the same signal.
preserved.xr: Existing native first-person VR and actual-geometry diorama VR/AR. Top, front or both openings; never both closed. Display scale and cutaways do not change collision or progress. Manual placement only.

roadmap.next: Observe unfamiliar and returning riders, then give the existing elevated observation route useful goods-flow information without compulsory repeat exposition or another map expansion.

evidenceRetention: Raw accepted-runtime and public reports, screenshots, local validation and failures are included in Working_Quay_v0.12.1_Release_Verification.zip. Actions artifacts have their own retention limits; this permanent receipt records their IDs and digests.
recordScope: This receipt is outside the game-file publication closure. Creating it does not change the verified runtime or require recursively publishing another game evidence revision. Its presence in GitHub is distinct from separately testing the receipt's own Pages URL.
rollback: A new narrowly scoped Working Quay revert commit with save and public checks; never reset or force-push shared master.
